transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on today's receiving huddle. We have three lots to review: Lot R with vehicle-maintenance consumables, Lot M with temperature-sensitive medical consumables, and Lot C with rechargeable communications batteries. Before I sign any distribution dispositions, I need each of you to confirm your count check, condition check, and destination confirmation for each lot. Please also make a formal huddle entry now for any exceptions, discrepancies, or directives affecting any of these lots. Let's start with Lot R — warehouse, what's your status?
